tests.name: live coder Subagent smoke merges two disjoint real-repository candidates with TypeScript diagnostics and selected Vitest

limits: Commands, semantic LSP, debuggers and unknown tools conservatively depend on the complete visible source tree.
Interrupted merge attempts are retained and blocked pending reconciliation; they are not blindly replayed.
Missing destination parent directories are not created by the reused filesystem transaction.
The local Node COW interface returned ENOSYS; only automatic fallback and forced copying were exercised.
